semantics.purpose: Terminal acquisition-method coverage for every WHR tier.
semantics.method_complete: Method completeness means a source/discovery basis, trigger class, cadence class, and fail-closed zero policy are defined. It does not claim that a live fixture exists or that a runner is implemented.
semantics.best_available: Observed meeting rank is derived from acquired evidence elsewhere. This contract never fixes acquisition rank by country, authority, source, collector, or adapter.
semantics.fail_closed: Stale dates, prior-year dates, recurring cultural dates, secondary-only dates, and postponed dates never become current meetings without the defined current official trigger.
semantics.runner_state: Runner implementation readiness is separate from acquisition-method completeness.
